story.iWant: calculate a confidence score for each answer
story.soThat: low-confidence answers route to HITL review

task.item: Method: async def calculate_score(context_chunks, answer, token_logprobs) -> ConfidenceResult
Component 1 (40%): Retrieval Confidence = max(similarity_scores) from context chunks
Component 2 (30%): Source Consistency = avg pairwise cosine similarity of top-5 chunk embeddings
Component 3 (30%): Generation Confidence = extract from token logprobs or infer from response structure
Return: ConfidenceResult with overall score + component breakdown
Method: async def route_answer(bot_id, confidence_score, threshold) -> RoutingDecision
If confidence < threshold: decision = "hitl", add to HITL queue
Log routing decision with confidence components
Create confidence_logs table: bot_id, query_id, retrieval_confidence, source_consistency, generation_confidence, overall_confidence, routing_decision
Store all components for analytics and calibration
Test confidence calculation with various input combinations
Test routing: high confidence → auto-send, low → HITL
Test source consistency: agreeing chunks → high, contradictory → low

criterion.title: Three-Component Confidence Score
criterion.then: score combines: Retrieval confidence (40%), Source consistency (30%), Generation confidence (30%)

criterion.title: High Confidence Auto-Send
criterion.then: answer is sent directly to end-user AND marked as "Auto-responded"

criterion.title: Low Confidence HITL Routing
criterion.then: answer routes to HITL queue AND user sees "I'm checking with the team..."

constraints.constraint: Source consistency detects contradictory chunks (reduces hallucination risk)
